source.described_commit_note: This packet describes the E1-B relation-discovery code commit e48dfa2 (web/), added after the branch was realigned onto main (which now contains PR #9). The packet files themselves are added in the following commit on the same branch/PR.

scope: Cross-asset relation discovery gated on the public retrieval-phase (KnowledgeCardReady / AC-30) contract. Adds to the existing E1-B status shell; no E1-B milestone is claimed.

quality_mapping.acceptance_criteria_note: AC-30 (phase-gated cross-asset RAG) is the primary contract this change renders. AC-17 (no fabricated progress) and AC-15 (invalidation) are preserved.

input.fixture_or_scenario_id: checked-in retrieval-phase traces (relation-ready, relation-no-match, relation-confirmed, relation-detail-denied, relation-invalidated) in web/src/data/traces/
input.sha256_reason: Trace fixtures are validated at test time against the vendored JSON Schema and independently against the public AC-30 checker; the vendored schema hash is in web/contracts/rag-contract-provenance.json.

contract_vendoring.note: Byte-identical vendoring under rag-contract-provenance.json; verify:contracts enforces 10/10 files.

hardware.note: local developer workstation (macOS, arm64); not the W7900 GPU gate

model_and_serving.note: E1-B is a frontend status shell; no model was loaded. The real W7900/ROCm model-viability gate is Lane A / Issue #5.

commands.result: realign onto main (contains PR #9); no web/ conflicts
6 passed (relation states, real chromium, screenshots captured)
9 mock states passed (live-backend test not run here)

gate_proof.gate_1_readiness_before_candidates: deriveRelationDiscovery drops any relation_candidate_search seen before an accepted knowledge_card_ready and records a gate violation; proven by relationView.test.ts.
gate_proof.gate_2_confirmation_before_detail: detail stays DENIED until a relation is CONFIRMED; a relation_detail_retrieval before confirmation is refused and recorded; proven by relationView.test.ts.
gate_proof.official_alignment: The same two gates are enforced independently by the backend qa suite (qa/tests/test_qa_framework.py) and the AC-30 checker, which all five UI trace fixtures pass.

non_goals: No M1 refinement feature, export/deletion, direct SQLite/vLLM access, invented backend state, public tunnel, analytics, or performance claim.
No unilateral contract/schema change: the retrieval-phase schema is vendored verbatim from main.
No E1-B milestone promotion is claimed.
